# AI Admin

> AI profile management, health monitoring, and workflow orchestration platform

## Start here (LLM navigation)

1. Fetch [/docs/manifest.json](/docs/manifest.json) — section-level index with summaries and anchors
2. Read only the sections relevant to your task (do not load entire handbook unless needed)
3. For Lovable apps: start with `lovable-integration` → enforcement rules → edge function modes
4. For Cursor/API work: start with `integration-guide` patterns → `api-reference` endpoints
5. For building workflows from user intent: read `workflow-builder` decomposition algorithm

## Documents

- [Manifest (section index)](/docs/manifest.json): Machine-readable navigation tree — fetch this first
- [Integration Guide](/docs/INTEGRATION.md): Edge Function proxy, auth, patterns, pitfalls
- [API Reference](/docs/API.md): Complete REST API endpoint reference
- [Concepts](/docs/CONCEPTS.md): Architecture, entity model, workflows, health monitoring
- [Lovable Handbook](/integration/AI_ADMIN_LOVABLE_INTEGRATION.md): Full Lovable integration handbook
- [Edge Function](/integration/ai-admin-supabase-edge-function.ts): Reference Supabase Edge Function
- [Workflow Builder](/integration/WORKFLOW_BUILDER_PROMPT.md): LLM prompt for workflow decomposition
- [Test Page Spec](/integration/AI_ADMIN_TEST_PAGE_SPEC.md): Minimal integration test page
- [Changelog](/docs/CHANGELOG.md): Version history and release notes
- [SDK packages](/docs/API.md#config-sync): `@ai-admin/types`, `@ai-admin/client`, `@ai-admin/edge` (monorepo `packages/`)

## Source of truth in repo

All docs are authored in `docs/` and synced to `frontend/public/` via `node scripts/sync-docs.mjs`.
